title: Single outbound calls and request receipts

rules.text: Always pass the customer’s verified from_number on a shared agent. If omitted the engine selects the oldest eligible number for the owning account and agent, ordered by created_at then id.
rules.why: A successful call from the wrong customer’s number is still a routing error for your application.

rules.text: Outbound developer instructions do not inherit the agent’s inbound system_prompt or the number’s custom_prompt.
rules.instead: Include the business and purpose in prompt or the recipient’s prompt_override. Fixed call rules and enabled knowledge and tools can still apply.

rules.text: Track an outbound request using its receipt. Preserve the request ID across an uncertain response and check its status before another dial.
Send agent_id, from_number, to_number and a meaningful prompt. Choose dynamic_vars for this call.
The route rejects a blank prompt. A nonblank string shorter than [[act-min]] trimmed characters may reach the no-purpose apology and end instruction.
Create the call and look up the durable request status when an ID is returned.
from_number_not_found means the supplied sender is ineligible. Check account ownership, assignment and the number’s outbound controls.
